description: Ask the board's apply agent to submit an application to this job on behalf of the key's owner. Needs an account key (mint one at https://resumebooster.work/agents), an active Agent plan OR a live Agent Pass (bought signed-in at https://resumebooster.work/agents/pass), and a mandate set in Account — call key_status first: it says which of the three is missing, and on a pass how many applications and how much time are left. Every application passes the same gates as the signed-in flow, including the honesty classifier: answers are drawn from the owner's own profile and never invented. Ask the person for a yes on this specific job id before calling. Needs a key or a sign-in.

note.description: Optional note stored with the request (not sent to the employer).

name: request_application

accepted.description: False when a gate refused; true when the request is in the agent's queue (or already was).

alreadyQueued.description: Accepted only: this job was already in the queue — nothing duplicated, and on a pass nothing spent.

error.description: Refused only: what the gate said.

fitPct.description: Keyword fit of the résumé on file to this posting, 0-100; null when the posting has no text to score.

fix.description: Refused only: what would change the answer.

passApplicationsLeft.description: Accepted on a pass: applications left on it after this one. Null when a subscription funded the request.

queueStatus.description: With alreadyQueued: the existing row's status.

refusedBy.description: Refused only: the gate — key, jobId, mandate, resume, plan (no Agent plan and no live pass), pass (the pass has no applications left or its clock ended), posting, scope-country, scope-category, scope-age, scope-salary.

warning.description: Accepted but flagged: below the release floor, or a system the agent prepares for rather than submits to.

title: Request an application
